items.b: 1 Ferry Wharf serves seafood, shared plates and casual meals beside Conanicut Marina. Its adjacent Sugar Shack adds ice cream to the waterfront outing. A useful detail for visitors: although the business is named 1 Ferry Wharf, its own website gives the street address as 3 East Ferry Wharf.
nt: Seasonal waterfront operation; check opening dates.

items.b: Ace's Pizza serves pizzas, calzones, grinders, sandwiches, burgers and salads from the McQuade's shopping plaza. Customers can eat in or order takeout, making it a practical stop for an everyday meal. Its location beside the island's grocery store allows residents to combine food shopping with a prepared meal.

Angel's Kitchen is a small restaurant on Narragansett Avenue, listed by both Discover Newport and Rhode Island's tourism office. It adds another independent dining option within the village's walkable shopping area. The business uses a public Facebook page for its online presence; call for the current menu and opening arrangements.

Art's Complete Automotive traces its beginnings to Art and Jan Washburn in 1977. The business offers vehicle maintenance and repair, along with body work and restoration services. That combination makes it a local contact for both routine transportation needs and more extensive work on a vehicle.

Atlantic Lawn & Garden provides landscape design, installation and maintenance, along with masonry and tree care. Founded in 1997 by Nick DiGiando, the company has Jamestown roots and serves southern Rhode Island. Its design services include three-dimensional planning, allowing clients to review proposed outdoor spaces before installation.

BankNewport's Jamestown branch provides personal and business banking on Conanicus Avenue. The bank dates its history to 1819, giving it a long Rhode Island connection beyond this individual branch. Customers can inquire about accounts, lending and mortgage services through the branch or the bank's website.

Shamus Flaherty started Beacon Hill Landscaping in 2003 as a one-person operation. The company now describes work ranging from regular mowing and garden care to planting, patios, walks and stone walls. Winter services include snow removal and property checks, giving the business a role beyond the growing season.
nt: Mailing address; service visits arranged directly.

items.b: Beech is a year-round restaurant and bar on Narragansett Avenue, offering indoor dining and outdoor seating in season. The restaurant combines a dinner menu with cocktails and private-event options. Its village setting makes it a convenient meeting place before or after a walk toward the waterfront.

Blossom is a family-owned artisan boutique featuring gifts, jewelry, art and furniture made by New England creatives. The shop grew from its founder's work in soft furnishings and upholstery. Its emphasis on regional makers gives customers an opportunity to learn who made the objects they are purchasing.

Brittain Electric provides electrical contracting services from its published Clinton Avenue address. Public listings connect the operation with the earlier Jack's Electric name and describe residential, commercial and industrial wiring. Customers should contact the business directly to discuss the intended work, current scheduling and the appropriate service arrangements.
nt: Public-directory contact details; current operation should be reconfirmed.

items.b: Campos develops technical towels and custom-printed products for activities such as sailing, golf and other outdoor recreation. A distinctive feature is its C-Lock attachment system, which allows a towel to serve additional purposes such as shade or a banner. The business also handles branded orders for organizations and teams.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Casey Tree Specialists provides tree care and related services in the Newport-area region. Its website dates the business to 1990 and also advertises crane rentals and firewood. Rhode Island DEM's arborist directory supplies the Jamestown business address, connecting the regional service operation to an island-based contact.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Cathryn Jamieson Salon is a full-service salon and day spa offering hair cutting, coloring and styling, nail care, waxing and bridal services. It identifies as an Aveda salon and also lists affiliated wellbeing practitioners. Those independent practitioners take their own appointments, while salon services are booked through reception.

Cavanagh Landscape Design is listed in Rhode Island DEM's directory of arborist companies with a Jamestown address and telephone number. It provides a local contact for inquiries about landscape and tree-related work. Detailed service descriptions and project availability should be established directly with the business.
nt: Published business address; services should be confirmed directly.

items.b: Central Garage appears in Rhode Island DMV inspection-station lists at its Narragansett Avenue address. Those records provide a public contact for vehicle-inspection inquiries, including listed specialist inspection categories. Call the garage to confirm whether it handles the particular vehicle, trailer or service required and to arrange an appointment.
nt: Inspection scope and availability should be confirmed directly.

items.b: Children's Wellness and Development Center provides evaluations and support for children, adolescents and young adults. Its services include psychological, neuropsychological and educational assessments, tutoring and parent consultation. The practice works with families and schools to translate findings into practical plans for learning and development.

David and Jennifer Clancy create handblown glass at their Jamestown studio. Their work spans functional glass objects and sculptural pieces, connecting a traditional craft with contemporary design. The studio's North Road setting offers a different kind of island shopping experience; arrange a visit directly rather than assuming village-store hours.
nt: Contact before visiting the studio.

items.b: Clark Boat Yard & Marine Works provides moorings, storage, maintenance and boat or yacht repair from Racquet Road. The yard is part of Jamestown's working marine economy, combining shoreside care with services for boats kept in the harbor. Contact the yard to discuss seasonal storage, repairs or mooring availability.

Bay Voyage Inn is a Victorian-style lodging property overlooking the bay from Conanicus Avenue. The resort's published description identifies a former private mansion adapted into 32 suites. Its setting gives the property a connection to Jamestown's older resort architecture, while the same address also hosts JB's on the Water.

Newport Overlook is a Jamestown resort offering two-bedroom condominium-style accommodations, with full kitchens described on Wyndham's website. Despite the Newport name, the property is on the Jamestown side of the bay. Booking sites report a closure through January 26, 2028; contact Wyndham directly for the current operating status.
nt: TEMPORARILY CLOSED per booking-site notices; dates may change.

items.b: Coastal Dental's Jamestown office provides dental care within a practice that also has locations in Seekonk and Fairhaven. Founder Dr. Jennifer Kuchar established the practice around patient care and comfort. Its published services span preventive, restorative and cosmetic dentistry, with the local office handling appointments and questions about available treatment.

Conanicut Care is an independent health-advocacy and care-navigation practice supporting individuals and families through medical and later-life decisions. Its work includes helping clients understand options and coordinate care. The practice states that it works independently of insurers, medical providers and facilities, defining its role as support for the client.
nt: Published business address; arrange consultation in advance.

items.b: Conanicut Gift Shop sells island-themed gifts, clothing, footwear, outdoor wear and merchandise associated with the local ferry and cruise operation. An arcade added in 2025 introduced 20 games and space for parties or outings. The combination gives the shop an additional role as a family activity destination.

Conanicut Island Associates owns and manages commercial property, including the Jamestown Design Building. Its role is in the village's business premises rather than a retail service. Prospective commercial tenants or others with property inquiries can contact the company using its published telephone number or mailing address.
nt: Mailing address.

items.a: 1050 Fort Getty Road; mail: PO Box 675
items.b: Conanicut Island Sailing Foundation promotes access to the water through sailing, marine education and community programs. Its Fort Getty site hosts activities and boat rentals, with availability dependent on the program calendar and staffing. The nonprofit connects recreation with learning about the bay and responsible use of its environment.

Conanicut Strategies advises mission-driven organizations on strategy, public affairs, policy, planning and communications. Founder Marisa A. Quinn is a lifelong Jamestown resident whose background includes 20 years at Brown University. The practice's published areas of expertise include higher-education leadership, administration and communications.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Contemporary Landscaping is listed by the Rhode Island Builders Association for landscape and hardscape work, excavation, septic systems and site utilities. Ronald J. Goldsmith is the published contact. Its range extends from visible outdoor improvements to the underground and preparatory work that supports a construction project.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Corliss Diesel specializes in marine diesel engine service and repair. Its North Road address gives boat owners a Jamestown contact for mechanical work distinct from general dockage or marina services. Discuss the engine make, symptoms and vessel location directly with the business before arranging service.

items.n: Crudo Oyster Bar & Coastal Italian Kitchen
items.b: Crudo brings a coastal Italian menu to Narragansett Avenue, with oysters, raw-bar selections, pizza, pasta, desserts and cocktails. Its Chamber profile records an opening date of December 17, 2025, making it a recent addition to the village's dining scene. Consult its own menu for current offerings.

Cumberland Farms combines a convenience store with a fuel stop on North Road. It offers a practical place to pick up coffee, drinks, snacks and basic provisions while traveling around the island. The Jamestown location is part of the regional Cumberland Farms chain, rather than a separate independent market.

Daniel Forster specializes in sailing and marine photography, alongside portraits, architecture and fine-art work. His Newport Chamber biography describes photographing 12 Olympic Games and 14 America's Cup events through 2024. A particularly notable assignment produced TIME magazine's 1987 cover photograph of America's Cup winner Dennis Conner.
nt: Studio inquiries by appointment; alternate published phone: 401-423-1900.

items.b: DB Builders is publicly listed as a residential contractor based on Washington Street, with David Brayman identified as the business contact. It provides another island-based starting point for building-project inquiries. The available listing contains limited company background, so project types, scheduling and current business details should be confirmed directly.
nt: Directory-based listing; current operation not independently confirmed.

items.b: DiMauro Architects designs coastal residential projects, with work encompassing architecture, interiors and the treatment of existing buildings. Its portfolio reflects the design questions associated with New England homes and waterfront settings. The Howland Avenue office provides a local point of contact for discussing a new residence, renovation or restoration project.

East Bay Bed & Breakfast occupies a house built around 1892 near the village waterfront. Accommodation includes four rooms with private baths and a two-bedroom suite; the inn also displays work by local artists. Its Union Street location puts guests within walking distance of village shops, restaurants and ferry access.

East Ferry Deli serves breakfast, sandwiches, soups and baked goods near the waterfront. The business's location on Conanicus Avenue makes it useful for ferry passengers, boaters and residents collecting food for the day. Breakfast and sandwich preparation follow different schedules, so early sandwich orders should be arranged directly.

Fuller Art and Frame Gallery combines custom framing with a gallery of fine art and handmade gifts. Its Chamber profile describes work by more than 75 area artists, including painters, ceramicists, jewelers, woodworkers and glass artists. The breadth of media makes it useful for both framing a personal piece and finding a locally made gift.

Gnarly Sheep Design Studio is the creative practice of an art director, illustrator, painter and graphic designer. The business provides a local contact for visual work that spans commercial design and fine art. Its range is useful for clients who need both an original image and a way to apply it to a project.
nt: Published studio address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Good Graces Grooming provides individual dog-grooming appointments, with its public description emphasizing anxious, older and special-needs dogs. Town records document a 2022 proposal to convert this former laundromat space to dog grooming. Owners should discuss their dog's coat, comfort and handling needs directly when arranging an appointment.
nt: Contact details from public listings; website could not be independently reviewed.

items.b: Grapes & Gourmet combines a wine and spirits shop with specialty foods on East Ferry Wharf. Its offerings include cheeses, gift baskets, platters and provisions suited to a picnic or a day on the water. The waterfront location connects food shopping with the wharf's boating and ferry activity.

Haabco Construction dates its work to 1995 and advertises residential and commercial construction services. Its range includes new construction, remodeling, siding, windows, doors and decks. The mix allows clients to ask about both a complete building project and a more focused improvement to an existing property.
nt: Published business address; arrange visits in advance.

items.b: Hälsosam Therapy is Dr. Gretchen Blycker's mindfulness-based psychotherapy practice. Her published work includes relationship and sexual-health concerns, with appointments available through the practice's contact system. The office occupies the second floor of 16 Narragansett Avenue; contact the practice to discuss availability and the format of an initial consultation.

Home at 2 Design offers interior-design services ranging from space planning and floor plans to lighting, finishes, fabric selection, art placement and staging. The business also incorporates antiques into its identity. Its Walcott Avenue location provides a Jamestown contact for coordinating the many decisions involved in furnishing or updating a home.
nt: Contact for appointments.

items.a: Jamestown, RI 02835; street address not published on the business website
items.b: Hull Electric identifies Jamestown as its home base and offers a direct telephone number and online inquiry form for electrical-service requests. Its website allows customers to describe a proposed job before arranging service. A street address is not given on the business's contact page, so inquiries should begin by phone or online.

Hunter Greens appears in Rhode Island DEM's arborist-company directory with a Sloop Street business address. The listing supplies a Jamestown contact for tree-care inquiries. Because the public record gives limited background, customers should discuss the exact work, site visit and current availability directly with the business.
nt: Published business address; services should be confirmed directly.

items.b: H.V. Holland is a heating and air-conditioning business listed by the Rhode Island Builders Association. It also appears among the Jamestown Community Chorus's local business supporters. These published contacts provide a way to inquire about heating and cooling work while connecting the business with the island's community life.
nt: Mailing address; published office address: 2 Hammett Court.

items.b: Island Animal is a pet-supply shop carrying food and equipment for companion animals. Public listings describe products such as toys, leads and training accessories alongside pet food. The store is distinct from Jamestown Animal Clinic: it is a shopping resource for pet owners, while the clinic provides veterinary care.

Island Heron Yoga is a women-owned studio offering group classes in several yoga styles, including prenatal yoga. It also provides individual and small-group sessions, in-home instruction and a 200-hour teacher-training program. The studio's entrance is at the rear of its Narragansett Avenue address.

Island HR provides human-resources consulting and business support. Its published services include risk management, strategy development and operational planning, with attention to employee engagement and workplace needs. The Jamestown-based practice offers an option for organizations seeking outside HR expertise rather than maintaining every function internally.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Island Power was established in 2014 and provides electrical installation, maintenance and repair for residential and commercial properties. Its services also include commercial fire alarms and annual maintenance for Generac standby generators. The Clinton Avenue business gives residents a local contact for both everyday electrical work and backup-power upkeep.

Island Realty at Residential Properties handles real-estate sales and rentals from its East Ferry Wharf office. Its work covers Jamestown and other Rhode Island communities. The waterfront office offers a local contact for buyers, sellers and people seeking rental property, with current listings available through the firm's website.

Jamestown Animal Clinic provides veterinary services on Narragansett Avenue and is associated with Newport Animal Hospital. It gives island pet owners a local point of contact within a larger veterinary practice. Call the clinic for appointment availability, services offered at this location and instructions for care outside regular hours.
nt: Email reaches the parent veterinary practice.

items.b: Jamestown Arts Center presents exhibitions, classes, camps, performances, talks and film programs. It is a nonprofit cultural resource with both public events and opportunities to make art. Its Valley Street location gives residents and visitors a place to encounter contemporary work and participate in the island's creative community.

The Jamestown Chamber of Commerce supports local businesses through its member directory, events and community connections. It is a useful first contact for business networking and questions about member services. Its online index also helps residents discover both island businesses and regional companies connected to Jamestown.
nt: Mailing address.

items.b: Jamestown Fitness Center offers gym equipment, personal training and group classes from its Southwest Avenue location. Its Chamber listing notes that classes are available to nonmembers as well as members. That gives visitors and residents an option to inquire about individual classes without assuming a full membership is required.

Jamestown Golf Course is a public nine-hole course with a snack bar and lounge. Its own website dates the course to 1901, connecting present-day play with more than a century of golf on the island. The site also posts tournament and league information that may affect access on a particular day.

Jamestown Hardware supplies everyday repair and household needs, including hardware, paint, plumbing supplies, lawn and garden items, housewares and key services. Its Chamber profile also lists UPS service. The store's broad inventory makes it a practical village resource for small projects that would otherwise require a trip off the island.

items.a: Museum: 92 Narragansett Avenue; mail: PO Box 156
items.b: Jamestown Historical Society preserves and interprets the island's history through its museum and historic sites. Its responsibilities include the 1787 windmill, the 1786 Friends Meetinghouse and the Revolutionary-era Conanicut Battery. The museum on Narragansett Avenue provides a starting point for exploring these connections between the village and the wider island.

Jamestown Kitchen and Bath designs kitchens, bathrooms, mudrooms, laundry areas and other functional living spaces. Its work also includes coffee stations, bar areas and outdoor spaces. The business operates by appointment at its Narragansett Avenue location, allowing projects to begin with a discussion of the client's needs and layout.
nt: By appointment only.

items.b: Jamestown Newport Ferry provides seasonal passenger transportation linking Jamestown with Newport-area stops, including waterfront destinations and attractions. It is part of the Cruise RI operation. The service is useful for a day across the bay, but routes, operating dates and weather-related changes should be checked before travel.

Jamestown Outdoors offers bicycle, kayak and stand-up paddleboard rentals, along with outdoor-related retail items. Founders Jason and Beth Hatch describe a family bicycle trip as part of the inspiration for the business. Rental arrangements can include delivery, so contact the business about equipment, pickup and the intended outing.

The Jamestown Press is the island's weekly community newspaper, covering local news, town affairs, people and events. Its website includes news archives and advertising information. The paper's Narragansett Avenue office provides a local contact for news submissions, announcements and business advertising.

Jamestown Primary Care is part of Brown University Health and provides family-medicine services on Southwest Avenue. The practice supports routine preventive care and ongoing health needs, with sick visits arranged by appointment. Its current system affiliation and practice name are useful when locating the correct office or patient information online.
nt: Use the office phone or patient portal for appointments; no public general email verified.

items.b: Jamestown Real Estate works with property in Jamestown, South County and Aquidneck Island. Its village office supplies a direct local contact for buying, selling and questions about current listings. The company's website provides property-search tools, helping clients begin a search before discussing the details with an agent.

Jamestown Wine & Spirits stocks beer, wine and spirits on Southwest Avenue. Alongside beverages, its Chamber listing notes Jamestown souvenirs, lottery sales and food items to take away. The business also maintains an online catalog, providing a way to browse products before visiting the shop.

JB's on the Water occupies a waterfront setting at the Bay Voyage property, overlooking Narragansett Bay and the Newport Bridge. The restaurant offers indoor dining, seasonal outdoor seating and weekend brunch. Its location is a distinguishing feature, with the water and bridge forming the backdrop to a meal.

Ken's Barber Shop provides barber services for adults and children on Conanicus Avenue. It is a straightforward local option for routine haircuts within the village. The business maintains a public social page under the Bestview name; call the shop to confirm current appointment or walk-in arrangements.

Latitude supplies and personalizes clothing and accessories for yachts, teams, events and individual customers. The company describes more than 35 years in crew gear, including technical and foul-weather clothing. Monogramming and custom decoration extend its work beyond sailing uniforms to everyday apparel and gifts.
nt: Contact for custom orders and visiting arrangements.

items.b: Lila Delman Compass maintains a Jamestown real-estate office on Narragansett Avenue. The firm handles sales and rentals, with its local profile emphasizing luxury and waterfront property. It also operates offices elsewhere in Rhode Island, connecting its island practice with a wider regional property network.
nt: Email reaches the firm's general contact.

items.b: Lionel Champlin Guest House is a historic Victorian inn on Lincoln Street, offering rooms with private bathrooms and an apartment option. Its website describes more than 20 years of hosting visitors. The setting suits travelers looking for a smaller village lodging property with convenient access to Jamestown and nearby Newport.

items.a: Bomes Theater Offices 34 Narragansett Avenue, Suite 1
items.b: Lisa Carlisle Architect specializes in residential architecture, including classic shingle-style homes and New England seaside design with modern elements. The office is in the Bomes Theater building on Narragansett Avenue. Its portfolio encompasses custom homes and renovations, with design shaped around the property and the household's requirements.

Mark E. Liberati Law Offices appears among the Jamestown Community Chorus's published local business supporters, with a Narragansett Avenue office and direct telephone number. That source establishes a community-facing professional contact. Call the office to confirm its current practice areas and whether it can assist with a particular matter.
nt: Directory-based contact; services and current operation should be confirmed.

items.b: McQuade's Marketplace is the island's full-service grocery store, with produce, meat, seafood, deli items, dairy products, prepared foods and floral offerings. The Jamestown location is part of a small regional operation that also has stores in Westerly and Mystic. It serves both everyday household shopping and boating provisions.

Milo's Nails & Spa is publicly listed as a nail salon on Narragansett Avenue, with manicures, pedicures and nail styling among the described services. It adds a personal-care option within the village center. Call to confirm the current service menu, booking arrangements and business details before making a visit.
nt: Directory-based listing; current operation not independently confirmed.

items.b: Munro Custom Contracting, known as MunroCo, specializes in custom homes, additions, garages and renovations in Jamestown. Its Chamber profile identifies Thomas Munro as the contact. The company provides a local starting point for discussing residential construction or alterations, with the scope and timing established directly with the contractor.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: Murphy-Prior and Infantolino is a law practice based on Narragansett Avenue. Its published contact details provide direct access to the local attorneys, with information available through the firm's website. Prospective clients should discuss the particular matter with the office to establish the appropriate services and representation.

The Narragansett Cafe combines a neighborhood restaurant and bar with live entertainment. Located on Narragansett Avenue, it is a place to check for local music as well as food and drinks. Performers and show times change, so its current entertainment calendar is the useful starting point for planning a visit.

Nauti Girl Boutique is a woman-owned coastal shop carrying clothing, shoes, accessories, gifts and beach-inspired decor. Its Jamestown location is on Conanicus Avenue, with another location in Narragansett. The selection is organized around coastal living, making it relevant to both island residents and visitors shopping for vacation wear.

Our Table Jamestown serves a seasonal, scratch-made dinner menu under executive chefs Marc Alexander and Marla Romash. The chefs divide their attention between savory cooking and desserts, a useful detail behind the restaurant's menu. The business operates year-round and offers outdoor seating when conditions allow.

items.n: Out of the Box Studio & Gallery
items.b: Out of the Box Studio & Gallery offers exhibitions, studio space and creative support in an inclusive environment. Its community includes artists with and without disabilities, as well as people developing their artistic practice. The Clinton Avenue gallery also provides opportunities for visitors to see and purchase artwork.

Pinheiro Construction works on custom homes, renovations and historic restoration. Its published capabilities also include decks and millwork, allowing a project to range from a specific building detail to a larger residential transformation. The company's Jamestown contact provides a starting point for reviewing the property, design and intended scope.

The Purple Door is an art and jewelry business on Conanicus Avenue, also identified through its public Facebook page as the Purple Door Bead Shop. It adds a small specialty-shopping stop to the waterfront end of the village. Contact the shop directly for current stock, custom work and opening arrangements.

R.A.M. Construction handles excavation and masonry, including foundations, site work, septic systems, pavers, walkways, terraces and driveways. Its Chamber profile recounts a beginning with a small dump truck and an assortment of small jobs. The company continues to describe work ranging from minor repairs to larger construction projects.
nt: Published business address; contact before visiting.

items.b: RI Real Estate Services provides buying, selling and leasing services through its Jamestown contact on Narragansett Avenue. The firm describes a full-service approach to local property transactions. Its office is a resource for discussing listings and market activity, with advice tailored to a specific property or search.

Ribbit Wellness offers yoga, meditation, wellness coaching and workshops from its North Road location. Its range combines movement-based classes with opportunities for reflection and individual support. Programs and schedules vary, so the studio's own calendar and direct contact are the best starting points for selecting a session.

S. Barzin Architect is Shahin Barzin's architecture practice, working on residential and commercial projects. His background includes architecture and interior-architecture study at the Rhode Island School of Design. The practice discusses technology and sustainable design alongside the character of the building, connecting technical planning with the way a space is experienced.
nt: Published practice address; arrange appointments in advance.

items.b: The Secret Garden combines a florist with a garden center on Southwest Avenue. Services and products range from arrangements for celebrations and memorial occasions to plants, gardening supplies and seasonal decorations. Its year-round identity changes with the season, from spring planting to autumn displays and holiday greenery.

Slice of Heaven is a village bakery, cafe and restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and baked goods. Its offerings also include seasonal treats and beverages, with the cafe functioning as both a quick stop and a place to sit down. The Narragansett Avenue address places it among the village's shops and restaurants.

Standards serves homestyle dishes and traditional family favorites at 40 Narragansett Avenue. Draft beer, wine and cocktails accompany the food. The restaurant's name reflects its focus on familiar meals, making its own current menu the best guide to the dishes and specials available on a particular visit.

Stephen Dargo's architectural practice publishes a Jamestown address and direct professional contact details. His portfolio and professional résumé provide the starting point for learning about past design work and discussing a potential commission. Contact the practice to confirm its current project availability and the arrangements for a consultation.
nt: Contact details are from a published 2024 professional résumé; reconfirm before publication.

items.b: Sunset Beach Oyster Bar links a Jamestown shellfish business with an oyster-bar setting on Narragansett Avenue. Its published business description identifies both shellfish farming and oyster service, giving the operation a direct connection to local aquaculture. Contact the business for current opening arrangements and oyster availability.

Susan Hackman, CPA, offers tax planning and preparation for individuals, businesses and trusts. Her published practice description also includes small-business accounting, consulting and QuickBooks experience. The combination serves clients who need continuing bookkeeping or business support as well as assistance at tax-filing time.
nt: Published business address; arrange appointments in advance.

items.b: TMT Construction is publicly listed as a Jamestown residential contractor associated with Thomas Tiernan. Its Buoy Street business listing supplies a local point of contact for construction inquiries. Detailed company history and current project scope were not established from a primary website, so prospective customers should confirm these directly.
nt: Directory-based listing; current operation not independently confirmed.

items.b: Tollgate Orthodontics operates a Jamestown location on Clinton Avenue in addition to its Warwick office. Its services include braces and clear-aligner treatment. A distinctive offering is the practice's own True brand of aligners; contact the office to discuss suitability, appointment locations and the current treatment options.

Conanicut Marina provides dockage and moorings at East Ferry. Its published profile describes more than 4,500 linear feet of dockage, capacity for vessels up to 225 feet and 150 moorings. The marina's village location places boaters near shops, restaurants and ferry connections.

Dutch Harbor Boat Yard is a full-service yard and mooring facility on Jamestown's west side. It offers boat storage and maintenance, with services supporting both the boating season and winter layup. Its location places it in a different harbor setting from the marinas and ferry facilities at East Ferry.

Taylor Point Boat Yard handles repair, maintenance, hauling, launching and storage for recreational and commercial vessels. The facility also lists Yamaha outboard sales and service. Its combination of indoor and outdoor storage with mechanical support makes it a year-round marine service location rather than solely a summer docking facility.

items.n: Trocki Paquin Attorneys and Counsellors at Law
items.b: Trocki Paquin Attorneys and Counsellors at Law offers legal representation and mediation. Its practice areas include divorce and family matters, estate planning and probate, business and employment issues, landlord-tenant matters and personal injury. Attorneys Kristine Trocki and Monique Paquin Duarte identify communication and conflict resolution as central to their approach.

TWC Home combines a shop with interior and landscape design services. Owners Deb and Toby present home furnishings and gifts alongside a garden setting at the Narragansett Avenue property. Visitors can browse the retail selection while also asking about larger projects for a room, home or outdoor space.

Village Hearth makes pastries, breads and cafe food from scratch, with sandwiches, soups and other offerings changing with the season. Owners Stephanie and Lindsay Haigh moved from Atlanta to Jamestown in December 2020 before taking on the bakery. The business brings a neighborhood cafe setting to Watson Avenue.

Wellworks is a Jamestown well and water-system business listed in the National Ground Water Association's contractor directory. Its public service descriptions cover well pumps and related water equipment. Contact the company with the property location and the type of water-system question to establish the appropriate visit or service.

Wildflower Farm grows seasonal flowers and offers bouquets, subscriptions and floral products from its Jamestown property. Its farm stand and online ordering connect customers directly with the grower, with local pickup and delivery options described on its website. Workshops and flower availability vary with the growing season.
nt: Seasonal farm stand; confirm visiting and pickup arrangements.

items.b: Windmist Farm is a family-run operation producing pasture-raised meats, eggs and seasonal vegetables. Customers can visit the farm shop and see its working agricultural setting on Weeden Lane. The farm's land-preservation story is documented by USDA, linking local food production with efforts to retain agricultural land on Conanicut Island.
nt: Farm website announces a seasonal store closing on November 1, 2026.

items.b: Wolpert Insurance & Risk Management's Chamber profile lists a Jamestown business contact for insurance services, including personal, commercial and marine coverage. The company website now directs visitors into World Insurance's organization. Contact the listed representative to confirm the appropriate office and arrange a discussion of current insurance services.
nt: Chamber-listed Jamestown contact; arrange appointments before visiting.
Nonprofit and community listings are separate from the 98 business entries.
